connector.name: Trello MCP Server by stucchi
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for the Trello REST API - manage boards, lists, cards, labels, checklists and more
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package trello-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the stucchi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TRELLO_API_KEY
env.description: API key from Trello Power-Up admin (https://trello.com/power-ups/admin)

env.name: TRELLO_TOKEN
env.description: User token generated for your Trello API key
